snippet.title: Funko Fusion - Yuletide Pack Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Happy Holidays from all of us on the Funko Fusion team! We’re excited to share a free stocking filler to spread some holiday cheer and thank you for being part of our growing community!

The free Yuletide Pack includes:
- Yuletide Freddy
- Yuletide Eddy
- Yuletide Foxxo
- Yuletide Proto

Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait to bring you more exciting adventures in 2025!

Join us on our community channels for the latest updates:
Website: https://www.Funkofusion.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/Kv6H3aGF
X: https://x.com/funkofusiongame
Instagram: https://instagram.com/funkofusiongame
